race.title: WTW Willis (Pro/Am) Flat Race
race.verdict: MISTER BOUM ran out an easy winner of his sole start in points and makes plenty of appeal on his Rules debut having joined all-conquering yard. Chanson du Jury is another fascinating contender having changed hands for big money on the back of a point success, while Ifuknowuknow is a likeable sort who should give his running once again. MISTER BOUM (FR) CHANSON DU JURY (IRE) IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
